notes.title: Rituals in the Dark Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

My newest VN, Rituals in the Dark, has been released! It's a short yuri VN with some vaguely spooky themes, with art by the same artist who worked on Sweetest Monster!
Rituals is nowhere near as dark as SM is, and the have very different stories, but they're very similar from a visual standpoint. If you liked the artwork in SM, you might like the visual design of Rituals, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118880/Rituals_in_the_Dark/

I hope you enjoy it, if you choose to pick it up. Thank you!

- ebi

notes.title: The Language of Love Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I thought I'd let you know I've released my newest VN, The Language of Love! It's a kinetic BxG romance story, and it's very different to Sweetest Monster. LoL is more of a 'standard' romance story, and it doesn't include any horror elements...
But, if you enjoyed the writing of Sweetest Monster, you might be interested in LoL all the the same.
LoL also has a few fanservice scenes and an 18+ patch that can be downloaded through Steam, if that's a dealbreaker for anybody haha
If you have any spare time, please consider checking it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027620/The_Language_of_Love/

Thank you!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:

I also fixed a handful of typos in the English text, but that's not particularly exciting haha

If you want to read the VN in Chinese, you now can! Isn't that neat?

- ebi
